data.title: 伽玛 · 地下指挥所的沙盘部署
data.description: 阴影庭园地下指挥所内，伽玛站在巨大的沙盘前调动棋子。暗影与阿尔法不在时，这里由她坐镇——每一步调动都精确如账目。
data.location: underground command chamber of shadow garden with a giant strategy sand table and wall maps
data.action: 站在巨大沙盘前从容调动棋子，目光严谨沉着，掌控全局
data.lighting: 沙盘上方魔石吊灯的冷白光与地图墙的微光
data.promptProse: Inside Shadow Garden's stone underground command chamber at night, Gamma stands poised over a vast strategic sand table in her gold-accented black slime suit and high-collared jacket. Reaching gracefully across the relief terrain to slide a carved marker piece into position, she surveys the wall maps behind her with composed, exacting precision. Cool white light from an overhead magic-stone chandelier sharpens the edges of the terrain and glints along the golden trim of her cuffs.
data.animaCaption: Standing beside the vast strategic sand table in the underground command chamber, Gamma reaches calmly forward to reposition a marker piece with poised precision. Cool white light from the overhead stone chandelier illuminates the terrain and wall maps behind her.
